items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1964-03-21
items.q: I used to go play with Jim Robinson. He was playing with a band at the Levita.

ctx.x: So after Sidney Desvene and Brand broke up, then I had to just come back to this Dick's land. I knew the chords, and the punch, you know, the chords is all the same. I knew all the pieces, because I heard them play it. I used to play it then. I played with Kid Renier. Played with Punch. I didn't play with Buddy Petit, because I was old enough, but at the time he was here, and I was in the country. I could have played with him. I used to go play with Jim Robinson. He was playing with a band at the Levita. That was…
I used to rest him up. No, yeah.

items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: People like Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Kit Howard, I mean...

ctx.x: How did you get hold of these men in the first place? Did they find out about you?
Well, these men are, you know, live here. Yeah. And a lot of them are quite famous. People like Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Kit Howard, I mean...
Excuse me for interrupting you here, Alan, but you said George Lewis. Now Lewis has just returned from Europe. How do you get him to come back here and play a one-night or a two-night stand?
